checks.name: benchmark completeness, source provenance and accuracy
checks.result: Four original-layout cases and two translated-LJ cases complete; seven timed samples per mode; all recorded source hashes verified against their exact source versions; all LAMMPS energy/force/virial relative errors <= 1e-10.

limitations: Only Reference and CPU OpenMM platforms are available; CUDA was not measured.
CPU timings use a shared host with an 8-CPU quota, not a dedicated node.
OpenMM Context pools retain per-copy public API transfers; native_batch remains false.
LAMMPS conservatively rebuilds when wrapped coordinates cross periodic faces, even for small unwrapped displacements.
Both the boundary-grid regression and the uniformly translated periodic-grid comparison are retained; no slower result was discarded.
Actual MPI correctness was exercised on one host, not a multi-node scaling benchmark.
MPIR_CVAR_CH4_CMA_ENABLE=0 is a managed-host workaround for unavailable cross-process memory access; it is not a production or CI code change.
Existing serial inputs retain their original metadata and scientific identity; explicit new mode/worker/skin options remain part of normal potential input identity.
